articles.title: AI button (bottom right)
articles.summary: Opens the AI copilot panel (the copilot). It is a button.

when: Wants to talk to the app.

articles.title: Another take / Refine / Ask the AI

articles.what: Find it in AI copilot panel.
when: Not happy with the first answer.

articles.title: Gear
articles.summary: Settings: your OpenRouter key and model (one model only), a daily spending cap, and "Let an AI assistant (Claude or ChatGPT/Codex) control Shokker Paint Booth" with... It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in AI copilot panel > top.

controls.label: Gear
controls.effect: Settings: your OpenRouter key and model (one model only), a daily spending cap...

Works together with the Connect ChatGPT / Codex control.

articles.what: Find it in AI copilot panel > gear. Changes appear in the AI panel with Undo.
when: Wants Claude to design the livery with the buyer's own plan.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.effect: Install Shokker into Claude Desktop, then ask Claude "Using Shokker Paint...

articles.title: Connect ChatGPT / Codex
articles.summary: Add SPB to Codex settings, restart Codex and sign in with ChatGPT. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in AI copilot panel > gear > bridge settings.
when: Wants ChatGPT / Codex to drive Shokker.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: Connect ChatGPT / Codex
controls.effect: Add SPB to Codex settings, restart Codex and sign in with ChatGPT
